buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses I. Eligibility Criteria: Vendors qualifying on following eligibility criteria shall be considered for further evaluation of their offers: 1. Bidder shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer(OEM) or an OEM-authorised dealer of the offered items. If the bidder is and authorized dealer, it shall submit a tender-specific authorization letter issued by the OEM clearly referring to the subject ten der/GeM Bid along with the bid. 2.Bidder/OEM shall have successfully supplied similar critical bearings in the past. For this purpose, the previously supplied bear ing shall have radial load capacity, inside diameter(ID)and outside diameter(OD)within ±20% of the corresponding values specif ied in the approved drawing. Documentary evidence of such successful supplies within last 10 years shall be submitted along wi th the bid. 3.Bidder shall confirm compliance with the approved drawing, technical specifications, material requirements, dimensional toler ances and inspection/ testing requirements. The offered bearing shall be manufactured strictly in accordance with the approved drawing.
